name: expo-offline-sync-monorepo
description: Deterministic, scoped, engine-agnostic offline request & mutation queue for Expo & React Native

scripts.version:patch: pnpm --filter expo-offline-sync version patch && pnpm build
scripts.version:minor: pnpm --filter expo-offline-sync version minor && pnpm build
scripts.version:major: pnpm --filter expo-offline-sync version major && pnpm build
